setup.title: Tool setup
setup.text: Kento converts images, PDFs, archives and text on its own. Video, audio and office files need free tools that Kento downloads once.
setup.privacy: Downloads come from the tools’ own builds and are checked against a fixed fingerprint before they run. Kento goes online only when you start a download.
error.codec.ffmpeg: This needs the media tools. Open Home and choose Complete setup.
toolchain.failed.network: The download stopped. Check the connection and try again; it continues where it stopped.
toolchain.failed.checksum: The download did not match its published fingerprint, so Kento deleted it. Try again.
toolchain.failed.unpack: The downloaded tools could not be unpacked. Try again.
toolchain.failed.msi: Windows could not unpack the downloaded installer. If another installation is running, wait for it to finish, then try again.
toolchain.failed.dmg: macOS could not open the downloaded disk image. Try again.
toolchain.failed.disk: The tools could not be saved. Check that there is free space.
toolchain.failed.check: This tool did not start, or it is older than version 6.
toolchain.failed.cancelled: Download paused. Install again to continue.
toolchain.failed.unavailable: These tools cannot be downloaded for this computer yet.
editor.proxy: Preview: lower quality, the result uses the original
editor.noPicture: No preview to show; the timeline still works.
editor.keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
editor.keys.tenth: A tenth of a second back or forward
editor.keys.inOut: Selection start and end at the playhead
editor.keys.ends: Go to the start or the end
editor.trim.title: Keep
editor.trim.hint: Drag the handles, or press I and O at the playhead, to choose the part that stays.
editor.crop.hint: Drag on the picture to draw the area, then move it or pull its edges. Shift keeps the ratio.
editor.crop.area: Crop area, {width} × {height} at {x}, {y}; the arrow keys move it
editor.speed.title: Speed
editor.speed.pitch: The sound follows the speed and keeps its pitch. The preview plays at this speed.
editor.merge.text: Drag the videos into the order of the result. The first one sets its size, frame rate and sound.

editor.frames.empty: Move to a moment and add its frame (M). Each frame is saved as a PNG in a new folder.
editor.split.noMarkers: Press M, or add a marker at the playhead, to split there.
editor.split.tooMany: That makes too many parts: at most {max}.
editor.split.summary: {count, plural, one {# part} other {# parts}}, {kept} kept
editor.redact.hint: Draw an area on the picture. It is hidden from the selection start to its end; I and O change that.
editor.redact.editing: I and O now set the time of area {index}. Click the picture outside the areas to draw a new one.
editor.normalize.text: Kento measures the loudness first, then adjusts it in a second pass (EBU R128).
editor.channels.title: Channels
editor.channels.source: {count, plural, =1 {The file is mono.} =2 {The file is stereo.} other {The file has # channels.}}
editor.channels.hint: How loud each channel will be. Mono mixes both into one; stereo plays the same sound on both.
editor.redactAudio.empty: Set a start and an end (I and O), then add the selection.
editor.visual.title: Picture
editor.visual.noImage: Choose an image for the video.
editor.visual.notImage: None of the chosen files is an image.
editor.visual.hint: The preview is a sketch; the video is made from the whole sound.
settings.tools.title: Tools
settings.tools.note: Kento uses a tool it finds on this computer before its own download. A program you choose must be FFmpeg 6, LibreOffice 7 or ExifTool 12, or newer.
toolchain.failed.busy: Wait for the download to finish, or cancel it, and try again.
toolchain.failed.remove: The tools are in use. Try again when the running jobs have finished.
error.codec.exiftool: This needs ExifTool from the Extras tools. Open Home and choose Complete setup.
error.codec.libreoffice: This needs LibreOffice from the Office tools. Open Home and choose Complete setup.
error.codec.ytdlp: Downloading from the web needs the media tools (yt-dlp and Deno). Open Home and choose Complete setup.
error.web.drm: This is protected by DRM, so Kento cannot download it.
error.web.live: This is a live stream. Kento downloads only videos that have ended.
error.web.login: This needs a signed-in account. Kento does not use your browser’s sign-in, so it cannot download it.
error.web.collection: This is a whole profile, channel or playlist. Kento downloads one video or post at a time: open the one you want and copy its link.
error.web.unavailable: This is not available: it may be removed, private or not shown in your country.
error.web.no-media: Kento found no video or picture at this address. On the site, use “Copy share link” and try that link.
error.web.network: The site could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
error.web.not-a-link: This is not a web address. Copy a link that starts with https://.
error.not-smaller: Kento could not make this file smaller, or not under the size you chose.
image.noPreview: No preview here; the result is still made from the original picture.
image.zoom.title: Zoom
image.keys.nudge: Move the chosen area or mark
image.keys.remove: Remove the chosen area or mark
image.keys.zoom: Zoom in, zoom out, fit in the window
image.keys.straight: While drawing: squares, circles and lines in 45° steps
image.keys.textEnd: Finish the text (Shift+Enter starts a new line)
image.keys.ratio: While resizing: keep the area’s ratio
image.color.title: Color
image.crop.area: Crop area, {size} at {x}, {y}; the arrow keys move it and Enter saves
image.crop.hint: Drag on the picture to draw the area, then move it or pull its edges. Shift keeps the ratio; Enter saves.
image.markup.tool.title: Tool
image.markup.hint.select: Click a mark to choose it and drag it to move it. Double-click a text to change it.
image.markup.hint.pen: Drag on the picture to draw freehand.
image.markup.hint.highlighter: Drag over what should stand out.
image.markup.hint.rectangle: Drag to draw a rectangle; Shift makes a square.
image.markup.hint.ellipse: Drag to draw an ellipse; Shift makes a circle.
image.markup.hint.line: Drag to draw a line; Shift keeps it in 45° steps.
image.markup.hint.arrow: Drag from the tail to the point; Shift keeps it in 45° steps.
image.markup.hint.text: Click where the text starts and type; Enter finishes it.
image.frame.blurredHint: The picture itself, blurred and stretched behind it.
image.collage.orderHint: Drag the pictures into the order of the collage, or move one with Alt and an arrow key.
image.redact.hint: Draw an area over what should be hidden. Draw more areas for other parts.

compress.left: {count, plural, one {# file can’t be compressed and is left out.} other {# files can’t be compressed and are left out.}}
compress.qualityHint: Lower values give smaller files with less detail. At 75 most pictures look the same as before.
compress.invalid: Type a size such as 25 or 2.5 MB.
compress.eachFile: The limit holds for each file on its own; Kento looks for the best quality that fits.
compress.searchHint: Kento looks for the best quality that still fits under this size.
compress.mediaNote: Video and audio are compressed with the media tools. If they are not set up yet, choose Complete setup on Home.
compress.pdfNote: PDF compression is an extra: it mostly makes the pictures inside smaller, so a PDF of plain text may not shrink.
compress.run: {count, plural, one {Compress the file} other {Compress # files}}
error.compress.unsupported: Kento cannot make this kind of file smaller in its own format. Convert it first, for example WAV to MP3 or BMP to PNG.
toolchain.failed.check.exiftool: ExifTool did not start, or it is older than version 12.
toolchain.failed.check.soffice: LibreOffice did not start, or it is older than version 7.
metadata.intro: Changes go into a new copy; the original stays as it is.
metadata.readOnly: Kento can show this format’s metadata but not change it.
metadata.field.title: Title
metadata.field.author: Author
metadata.field.subject: Subject
metadata.field.creator: Created with
metadata.hint.date: Year, month, day and time, such as 2024-05-01 14:30.
metadata.invalid.date: Write the date as year-month-day and time, such as 2024-05-01 14:30.
metadata.chapters.readOnly: This format cannot hold chapters, so they can only be viewed.
metadata.chapters.name: Chapter title
metadata.chapters.label: Chapter {number}
metadata.chapters.hint: Times as minutes:seconds or hours:minutes:seconds, such as 1:05 or 1:02:30.5.
metadata.chapters.invalid: Each chapter must end after it starts, before the file ends and before the next one begins.
metadata.removeAll.image: Keeps the picture’s orientation and colour profile, so it looks the same.
metadata.removeAll.media: Removes the fields, chapters and cover art; the picture and sound stay as they are.
metadata.removeAll.pdf: Removes the document information and the XMP metadata; the pages stay as they are.
metadata.removeLocation.hint: Removes where the file was made (GPS coordinates) and keeps everything else.
metadata.none: This file carries no other metadata.
